projects.title: Running rows
projects.line: One loud word runs past itself in rows, a picture cuts in, then the word stands whole: for a drop, a sale or a launch.

projects.title: Typed bloom
projects.line: A picture set in characters and typed over again by a sweep of light, with a name on a bar: for tech, data, AI and anything mysterious.

projects.title: Round and round
projects.line: A name circles a picture in rings that turn against each other, then takes its place: for a logo, a badge or a soft launch.

projects.title: Torn edition
projects.line: A picture is torn into bands and snaps back still, the word stamped on paper strips: for fashion, an edition or a night out.

projects.title: Quarter turns
projects.line: A wall of quarter circles turns in step and opens for a name: for design, architecture, food or any calm brand.

projects.title: Built in front of you
projects.line: A button unfolds into a product screen, fills itself in, is pressed and folds back: for an app, a shop or a SaaS launch.

projects.title: Breathing dots
projects.line: A picture printed in dots that swell in rings, with a name rising under it: for beauty, flowers, music and print.

projects.title: Up to a hundred
projects.line: A number climbs as a colour fills the frame, then bursts into the picture and the name: for a result, a milestone or sold out.

projects.title: Through the slits
projects.line: Nine slits open one after another on a picture, as in Reynaud’s drum, and a name stands in the middle: for a trailer, a place or a night.

projects.title: Frame in frame
projects.line: Frames fly out of the picture without end while it floats still in the middle: for sport, music and anything that loops.

projects.title: Say the film
projects.line: A ball, a slam and a run of short chapters cut on the beat, landing on the name: for a product's launch reel.
